task: Create multimedia travel marketing assets from scripts and stock/generative media, then deliver generated files by email and provide downloadable presentation content.

queries.query: generate multimedia travel marketing assets from scripts stock generative media
queries.intent: Generate media assets from scripts using multimedia creation tools

queries.query: send email with generated files or attachments
create presentation or slides downloadable presentation content
queries.intent: Provide downloadable presentation content or create presentation

arguments.prompt: Cinematic 4K travel marketing video showcasing a breathtaking tropical beach in Bali at sunset, crystal clear turquoise water, gentle waves, golden sunlight reflecting on the ocean, cinematic drone shot, high quality.

A stunning high-end travel marketing poster for a luxury resort in Bali, featuring an infinity pool overlooking lush green jungle and Mount Agung at sunrise, professional photography, highly detailed, vibrant colors.

arguments.inputText: Discover Bali: The Ultimate Luxury Travel Experience. Scene 1: Pristine beaches and crystal clear waters. Scene 2: Cultural immersion and ancient temples. Scene 3: Luxury resorts and world-class dining. Join us on an unforgettable journey.

arguments.body:
Hello,

Please find attached the multimedia travel marketing assets and review the presentation content generated for our new campaign.

Best regards,
Travel Marketing Team
arguments.subject: New Travel Marketing Assets & Presentation

final_message: Successfully generated multimedia travel marketing assets (videos and images) from scripts using Gemini, created downloadable presentation content using Gamma, and delivered the campaign materials via email using Gmail.
